title: An inheritance, lottery or fund transfer for a stranger
plain: It offers you a large sum (an inheritance, a lottery win, unclaimed funds), the classic advance-fee scam.

examples.phish:
Subject: Confidential

I am a bank manager. A late client left unclaimed funds of 12.5 million USD and you can be named next of kin. Contact me in confidence and we share 40 percent.
examples.legit:
Subject: Estate planning webinar

Join our free webinar on writing a will and naming beneficiaries.

title: Crypto giveaway or "double your coins" offer
plain: It promises free or doubled cryptocurrency if you send some first. That money is never returned.

examples.phish:
Subject: Official ETH giveaway

To celebrate, send 0.5 ETH to the address below and receive 1 ETH back, double your coins instantly!
examples.legit:
Subject: Your monthly statement

Your crypto exchange statement for October is ready in your account.

title: Says your mailbox is full or about to be closed
plain: It says your mailbox is full or will be shut down unless you act, a common way to steal email passwords.

examples.phish:
Subject: Mailbox storage limit

Your mailbox is full. Incoming messages are being held. Click to increase your storage now: https://mail-quota.example/upgrade
examples.legit:
Subject: Your Google storage

You are using 70% of your storage. You can manage it any time in Settings.

title: Asks for a small fee to release a parcel
plain: It says a parcel is held until you pay a small fee, a common card-stealing trick.

examples.phish:
Subject: Your package is on hold

Your package is on hold due to an unpaid customs fee of $1.99. Pay now to reschedule delivery: https://track-parcel.example/pay
examples.legit:
Subject: Your order has shipped

Good news, your order is on its way and should arrive Thursday. Track it in your account.

title: Claims to have hacked your camera and demands payment
plain: It claims to have recordings of you and demands money. It's a mass bluff; don't pay or reply.

examples.phish:
Subject: I know your password

I hacked your device and recorded you through your webcam while you visited an adult site. Pay $1500 in bitcoin to the wallet below within 48 hours or I send the video to your contacts.
examples.legit:
Subject: Security camera footage

The video of the delivery at your door was saved to your account.

title: Promises a tax refund you have to claim
plain: It promises a tax refund, a classic way to steal bank or card details.

examples.phish:
Subject: HMRC: you are eligible for a tax refund

You are eligible for a tax refund of 412.80 GBP. Submit your claim before Friday: https://hmrc-refund.example/claim
examples.legit:
Subject: Your tax return was received

Thank you. Your return was received and is being processed. No action is needed.

title: A "voicemail" or "missed call" you have to open
plain: It says you have a voicemail or fax to open. These are almost always a link to a fake login page.

examples.phish:
Subject: New voicemail (0:42)

You have a new voice message from +1 202 555 0123. Listen to the message here: https://voice-portal.example/listen
examples.legit:
Subject: Lunch?

I left you a voicemail earlier, call me back when you can.
